export.title: Export
export.fallback.oneEncoder: The encoder stopped responding: the render restarted on a single encoder.

export.privacy: Everything renders on your device - nothing is uploaded.

preferences.title: Preferences
about.tagline: A browser video editor for short-form social clips.
preferences.captions.hint: Models are downloaded once and run on this machine. Nothing you transcribe ever leaves your computer.
preferences.data.intro: SelfCut keeps everything in this browser: your projects, your media library and your settings. Nothing is sent to a server.
preferences.data.reset.heading: Delete my data
preferences.data.reset.lead: Erase everything SelfCut has stored in this browser. This cannot be undone.
preferences.data.reset.title: Delete all SelfCut data?
preferences.data.reset.body: Everything SelfCut has stored in this browser is erased and the app restarts empty. There is no undo, and no backup.
preferences.data.reset.item.projects: Every project, with its timeline, effects and markers
preferences.data.reset.item.library: The media library, and the audio and subtitle caches
preferences.data.reset.item.settings: Your preferences, back to their defaults
preferences.data.reset.safe: Your original video and audio files are left alone: SelfCut never changes or deletes the files you import from.
preferences.data.reset.keepModels.hint: They hold nothing personal, and they are the slowest thing here to download again.
preferences.data.reset.blocked: Another SelfCut tab kept the database open, so it could not be deleted yet. Close every other SelfCut tab, restart, then delete again.
preferences.data.location.hint: Imported media is copied into the folder you choose instead of the browser's own storage on the system drive. Projects, settings and caches stay in the browser, and the files you import from are never touched. SelfCut restarts after a move.

preferences.data.location.moveFailed_oth: {{count}} files could not be moved and stay where they were. SelfCut restarts now.
preferences.data.location.pickFailed: That folder could not be used.
preferences.data.location.unsupported: Choosing a storage folder for the media library needs Chrome, Edge or another Chromium-based browser. This browser keeps everything in its own storage.

errors.export.cannotClone: This browser would not copy part of the render to the export worker ({{field}}), and the fallbacks did not help either. Reload the page and export again; if it keeps happening, report it with that name.

handoff.folder.label: Editing folder
handoff.folder.description: XML timeline · one WAV per track · rushes
handoff.folder.hint: Opens in Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve with every cut, track, speed and level in place. Point it once to the rushes and every clip relinks.
handoff.includeRushes.hint: Untick if your editor already has the original files: the timeline will point to them by name.
handoff.rawSound: Raw sound: no loudness normalization, the volumes stay as set on the timeline. Your editor does the final mix.
handoff.done_one: Timeline and {{count}} audio track, ready for your editor.
handoff.done_other: Timeline and {{count}} audio tracks, ready for your editor.
handoff.readme.title: {{name}}: editing folder made with SelfCut
handoff.readme.xml: {{file}}: the timeline (Final Cut Pro 7 XML, {{fps}} fps). Cuts, tracks, speeds and clip levels.
handoff.readme.stems_one: {{folder}}/: {{count}} audio track, 24-bit 48 kHz WAV, mixed as heard in SelfCut, not normalized. Lined up from 00:00:00:00.
handoff.readme.stems_other: {{folder}}/: {{count}} audio tracks, 24-bit 48 kHz WAV, each mixed as heard in SelfCut, not normalized. All lined up from 00:00:00:00: together they sum to the mix.
handoff.readme.noStems: No audio track: nothing in this cut makes sound.
handoff.readme.rushes: {{folder}}/: the original files the timeline uses, under the names it refers to. When your editing application asks for the media, point it to this folder: the other clips relink on their own.
handoff.readme.relink: Rushes not included: when asked, point your editing application to your copy of the original files (same names).
handoff.readme.generated_one: {{count}} title, colour or shape is not in the XML: it has no equivalent there. Ask for a video master to see it.
handoff.readme.generated_other: {{count}} titles, colours or shapes are not in the XML: they have no equivalent there. Ask for a video master to see them.
handoff.readme.ramped_one: {{count}} clip with a speed ramp is not in the XML (xmeml has no form for a ramp), and plays silent in SelfCut as in the stems. Ask for a video master to keep it.
handoff.readme.ramped_other: {{count}} clips with a speed ramp are not in the XML (xmeml has no form for a ramp), and play silent in SelfCut as in the stems. Ask for a video master to keep them.
handoff.readme.premiere: Premiere Pro: File > Import, pick the .xml.
handoff.readme.resolve: DaVinci Resolve: File > Import > Timeline, pick the .xml.
errors.handoff.tooLarge: The folder would exceed 4 GB. Untick "Include the rushes" and send them separately.
